subject: Changing the cleanup meeting
text:
Hi,

We need to change our block cleanup planning meeting from Thursday 7 p.m. to Saturday 9 a.m. The hall is booked for a repair visit during that slot, so Thursday is not workable anymore. Saturday morning gives us more room before the weather turns, and it leaves time afterward for the tool shed check.

Please reply whether the new time works for you. I have attached the updated volunteer list and the supply checklist so everyone can see what shifted. If you cannot attend, send your task preferences by tonight and I will put you down for a shorter job.

Also, the attachment that was supposed to show the new street map is missing. I forgot to add it the first time, and I am sending a corrected copy separately. If your copy still has old notes, ignore them; the only issue is the map file. I will leave a printed map by your mailbox if the email does not arrive by morning.

Thanks for being flexible. The plan is simple: confirm Saturday, review the checklist, and let me know if you need a ride. I also asked the supply person to label the bins by color, so bring gloves if you have them. We only have about two hours, and we want to leave the street passable before lunch.
